gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Striking in its tight, compressed cadence, Expose is made for big, short lines. Noto Sans Cherokee sits underneath with a tall band of letters and short stalks, approachable and easy to settle into.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-chorasmian: Noto Sans Chorasmian has a large x-height and short ascenders, with curves that stop short instead of closing in. And Expose goes the other way, packing its caps and lowercase tight, so a bigger size for the heading and a gentler one below seems a fair suggestion.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-coptic: Clean, open shapes carry Noto Sans Coptic, with the middle zone of each line doing most of the work. Its best quality is how that spacious texture sits against Expose, a refined heading that packs its letters tightly.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-cuneiform: Clean and contemporary, Noto Sans Cuneiform opens its e wide and swells the lowercase into something like glass beads, a big contrast to the pressed-together Expose. Sharp above, round below.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-deseret: Squat, wide and friendly: Noto Sans Deseret has open apertures and a high lowercase with short ascenders, set under the tight-packed Expose heading. They make a crisp, compact top and a generous text.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-devanagari: Expose is a refined display face whose lowercase and caps nearly meet in height, giving a compressed, hurried rhythm. And Noto Sans Devanagari slows things down beneath it, with a compact skyline and a g whose lower curve stays open.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-duployan: Expose packs its letters tight, with hardly a pause between them. Noto Sans Duployan relaxes below it, with a wide-mouthed a and oversized counters that keep a long passage easy and open.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Contemporary and unfussy, Expose compresses its lettering into a striking, refined heading. Noto Sans Elbasan feels roomier next to it, with large lowercase forms and terminals that never pinch shut.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: Noto Sans Elymaic reads openly, its apertures wide and its ascenders barely rising above the x-height. And a longer passage in it feels clean and modern, a quiet counterpart to the tight Expose heading.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-ethiopic: Noto Sans Ethiopic is tall and sturdy, with c terminals that hang far from the bowl. Noto Sans Ethiopic gives the pair its strongest quality, a modern sturdiness that grounds the compressed, striking Expose.
